name: @pipeworx/mcp-insee

tools.name: insee_company
tools.description: Look up a French company or establishment in INSEE's official SIRENE business registry. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who is French company X", "details for SIREN/SIRET …", legal name, activity (NAF/APE code), address, headcount band, creation date, active/ceased status. Pass a 9-digit SIREN (legal unit) or 14-digit SIRET (establishment).

identifier.description: A SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits), e.g. "552032534" (Danone).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own INSEE SIRENE API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-insee forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the insee pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
